newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzuki minivan model exceeds sales target.
newsitem.headline: Suzuki minivan model exceeds sales target.

text.p: Suzuki Motor Corp said on Friday that domestic orders for its new Wagon R Wide, a minivan-type compact recreational vehicle, were far exceeding initial sales targets.
The carmaker received 8,700 orders for the vehicle in the first 24 days after its launch, compared with a monthly sales target of 2,000 vehicles.

Suzuki, owned 3.2 percent by General Motors Corp, introduced the Wagon R Wide on February 5. The vehicle offers a newly developed 1,000cc aluminium engine or a 1,000cc aluminium intercooler turbo-charged engine.
Suzuki is displaying the model as the Wagon R Plus at the 11-day Geneva car show which started on Thursday, a Suzuki spokesman said.
Suzuki hopes to start marketing the Wagon R Plus in Europe this summer, the spokesman said.
